purpose: Publishing a repository also publishes its whole past.

steps.condition: No credential in any file, in any commit, ever.
steps.refuses: A repository whose history still holds a key.

steps.condition: No absolute path, hostname or private address of the author's machine.
steps.refuses: Code that can only run in one house.

steps.condition: No file is byte-identical to another.
steps.refuses: Copy-paste, which drifts and reads as carelessness.

steps.condition: Every promise in the README is checked by a script that runs on every push.
steps.refuses: A README claiming a build that does not exist.

steps.condition: Each gate ships with a test proving it refuses.
steps.refuses: A guard with no proof of refusal.
